subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth attention in these incident descriptions.

judge.implied_focus: The nature/characterisation of incidents worth attention -- what kind of problem each incident is and whether it exhibits attention-worthy patterns (recurrence, cross-assignment, self-resolution)

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: Classifies the incident domain (database, email, vpn, etc.), a core facet of characterising what an incident is about.

per_column.name: problem_nature
per_column.rationale: Captures the type of failure (outage, access_denied, crash), directly describing what is worth attention about the incident.

per_column.name: affected_system_type
per_column.rationale: Identifies what class of system is impacted, a coherent facet of incident characterisation.

per_column.name: self_resolved
per_column.rationale: Flags whether the incident resolved itself, a meaningful attention signal distinguishing noise from real issues.

per_column.name: cross_assignment
per_column.rationale: Indicates handoff/reassignment, a process-friction signal relevant to what warrants attention.

per_column.name: recurrent_caller
per_column.rationale: This is a bare caller name enumeration; labelled 'recurrent' but values are just top callers, drifting toward a caller-directory attribute rather than an incident-attention facet.

per_column.name: opened_hour_of_day
per_column.rationale: A near-uniform temporal extraction with no discriminating signal; a generic time-derived feature not centred on incident attention-worthiness.

judge.rationale: The majority of columns (category, problem_nature, affected_system_type, self_resolved, cross_assignment) cohere well around a single inferable focus: characterising incidents to surface what merits attention. This gives a sound multi-facet structure spanning what/where/how-handled at a useful granularity, and the focus is genuinely actionable (an analyst can triage by problem type, spot self-resolving noise, and flag cross-assignment friction). However, coherence is diluted by two weaker additions: recurrent_caller collapses to a bare caller enumeration (an attribute more about people than incident nature), and opened_hour_of_day is a near-uniform, low-information temporal extraction that adds noise rather than an attention signal. These prevent top marks but do not make the set a scattered grab-bag; the centre of gravity remains a coherent, investigable incident-attention focus.
